title: Flashfire Release
body:
Flashfire Release forms from Fire + Lightning. Choose a second nature at level 25 after revealing your first at level 10; Dust Release additionally requires a third nature revealed at level 100. Clan Kekkei Genkai holders cannot gain an elemental release.

Techniques:
Level 25: Flash Spark (help flash spark)
Level 45: Blazing Pulse (help blazing pulse)
Level 70: Flashfire Storm (help flashfire storm)
